Real Estate Research

Designed for Kenya

Buying or selling property in Kenya? Plotwise gives you parcel/L.R. search, valuation insights, and due-diligence reports.

Map Visualization

Explore land parcels on Google Maps with cadastral data, zoning, riparian context, administrative boundaries, and survey mapping layers including Cassini/UTM sheets. Search by parcel number, L.R. number, block, address, or coordinates.

Check it out

Research Reports

For both mapped and unmapped parcels, Plotwise cross-references L.R. numbers against the Ndungu Report, court cases, NCA approvals, and other key records for due diligence. You can also view nearby schools, hospitals, and other useful places around a parcel.

Check it out

Community Posts

Explore upcoming developments around you with updates from Plotwise and crowdsourced submissions. Stay informed about what’s being proposed or built near your home, neighborhood, or areas you follow, whether you're a resident, developer, or real estate professional.
